The World Bank open data site is expanding to Data360, a newly curated collection of data, analytics, and tools to foster development. This is an ongoing effort and we welcome your feedback

The Atlas of Global Development 2026 presents interactive storytelling and data visualizations on key global trends related to people, prosperity, our planet, infrastructure, and digital transformation.

Select an economy on the map to see data and access the economy profile

World Development indicators, a compilation of relevant,high-quality, and internationally comparable statistics about global development and the fight against poverty.

Datasets and features on different Worldbank data platforms

Visualise and analyse WDI and other World Bank time series data inDataBank.

Find data collected through sample surveys in theMicrodata Library.

Download publicly available World Bank datasets from theData Catalog.
